params.QUERY: SELECT column_name,datatype,description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name='dr4.photometry'

body:
column_name,datatype,description
ccd,SMALLINT,CCD on which the object was detected (1-32)
e_flux_ap10,REAL,Error in 10 arcsec aperture flux
e_mag_apc10,REAL,Error in 10 arcsec aperture magnitude
flux_ap15,REAL,Total counts within 15 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
e_flux_ap15,REAL,Error in 15 arcsec aperture flux
e_mag_apr15,REAL,Error in 15 arcsec aperture magnitude
flux_ap20,REAL,Total counts within 20 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
e_flux_ap20,REAL,Error in 20 arcsec aperture flux
e_mag_apr20,REAL,Error in 20 arcsec aperture magnitude
flux_ap30,REAL,Total counts within 30 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
e_flux_ap30,REAL,Error in 30 arcsec aperture flux
e_mag_apr30,REAL,Error in 30 arcsec aperture magnitude
use_in_clipped,SMALLINT,Flag indicating whether this observation was used in computing the clipped mean magnitudes in the master table
img_qual,SMALLINT,Quality level of this image from 1=best to 3=worst
a,REAL,Length of object semi-major axis in pixels
b,REAL,Length of object semi-minor axis in pixels
background,REAL,Mean background level in counts
chi2_psf,REAL,Reduced Chi-squared of PSF fit
class_star,REAL,Source Extractor stellarity index (between 0=not star and 1=star)
decl_img,DOUBLE,ICRS Declination of the object on this image
e_a,REAL,Error in semi-major axis
e_b,REAL,Error in semi-minor axis
e_flux_ap02,REAL,Error in 2 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_ap03,REAL,Error in 3 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_ap04,REAL,Error in 4 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_ap05,REAL,Error in 5 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_ap06,REAL,Error in 6 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_ap08,REAL,Error in 8 arcsec aperture flux
e_flux_kron,REAL,Error in Kron flux
e_flux_petro,REAL,Error in Petrosian flux
e_flux_psf,REAL,Error in PSF counts
elong,REAL,Object elongation (a/b)
e_mag_apc02,REAL,Error in 2 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_apc03,REAL,Error in 3 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_apc04,REAL,Error in 4 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_apc05,REAL,Error in 5 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_apc06,REAL,Error in 6 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_apc08,REAL,Error in 8 arcsec aperture magnitude
e_mag_kron,REAL,Error in Kron magnitude
e_mag_petro,REAL,Error in Petrosian magnitude
e_mag_psf,REAL,Error in PSF magnitude
e_pa,REAL,Error in position angle
filter,CHAR,"SkyMapper photometric filter (u, v, g, r, i, z)"
flags,SMALLINT,Flags raised by Source Extractor
flux_ap02,REAL,Total counts within 2 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap03,REAL,Total counts within 3 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap04,REAL,Total counts within 4 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap05,REAL,Total counts within 5 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap06,REAL,Total counts within 6 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap08,REAL,Total counts within 8 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_ap10,REAL,Total counts within 10 arcsec diameter aperture centred on object
flux_kron,REAL,Total counts within Kron ellipse
flux_max,REAL,Peak count above background of the brightest object pixel
flux_petro,REAL,Total counts within Petrosian ellipse
flux_psf,REAL,Total counts under PSF fit
fwhm,REAL,Object full width at half maximum on detector
imaflags,INTEGER,"OR-combined flagged pixel types within isophotal radius from bad, saturated, and crosstalk pixel mask"
image_id,BIGINT,Unique image ID as used by the Science Data Pipeline
mag_apc02,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 2 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc03,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 3 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc04,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 4 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc05,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 5 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc06,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 6 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc08,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 8 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apc10,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 10 arcsec diameter aperture, corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apr15,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 15 arcsec diameter aperture, NOT corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apr20,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 20 arcsec diameter aperture, NOT corrected for PSF losses"
mag_apr30,REAL,"ZP-corrected magnitude within 30 arcsec diameter aperture, NOT corrected for PSF losses"
mag_kron,REAL,ZP-corrected Kron magnitude
mag_petro,REAL,ZP-corrected Petrosian magnitude
mag_psf,REAL,ZP-corrected PSF magnitude
mu_max,REAL,ZP-corrected peak surface brightness of object above background
nimaflags,INTEGER,"Number of flagged pixels from bad, saturated, and crosstalk pixel mask"
object_id,BIGINT,Global object ID in master table associated with this observation.
object_id_local,BIGINT,"Object ID in this (image,CCD) tuple. Not globally unique."
pa,REAL,"Object ellipse position angle on sky (E of N, -90..+90 deg)"
radius_frac20,REAL,Radius of circular aperture enclosing 20 per cent of total (Kron) flux
radius_frac50,REAL,Radius of circular aperture enclosing 50 per cent of total (Kron) flux (i.e. half-light radius)
radius_frac90,REAL,Radius of circular aperture enclosing 90 per cent of total (Kron) flux
radius_kron,REAL,Radius of Kron ellipse in units of a and b
radius_petro,REAL,Radius of Petrosian ellipse in units of a and b
ra_img,DOUBLE,ICRS Right Ascension of the object on this image
x_img,REAL,CCD x-pixel coordinate of the object on this image
x_mosaic,REAL,Mosaic x-pixel coordinate of the object on this image
y_img,REAL,CCD y-pixel coordinate of the object on this image
y_mosaic,REAL,Mosaic y-pixel coordinate of the object on this image
